suggestions.title: SqliteAuditReportStore schema migration causing test failures
suggestions.rationale: SqliteAuditReportStoreTests and RetentionSweepTests fail in the full test suite with SQLite errors originating from SqliteAuditReportStore.CreateAsync (line 76). The failures are consistent across test runs and pre-date this PR. They appear to be a schema mismatch (missing column or table) in the audit report store SQLite schema, likely introduced in a recent migration. Affected tests: SqliteAuditReportStoreTests.RoundTrip_PreservesAllFields, GetByWorkItem_OrderedByIterationThenAuditorName, and 6 more. RetentionSweepTests.DeleteOlderThan_* (5 tests).

suggestions.title: Upgrade OTel packages once patched versions are available in local cache
suggestions.rationale: Two OpenTelemetry packages pinned in CodeyBox.Api have known moderate-severity vulnerabilities (GHSA-g94r-2vxg-569j for OpenTelemetry.Api 1.12.0, GHSA-4625-4j76-fww9 for OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol 1.11.2). These were the only versions available in the local NuGet cache at time of implementation. NuGetAuditSuppress entries have been added with comments to make them easy to find. Once patched versions are in the feed, remove the suppress items and bump the package versions.

suggestions.title: Add codeybox.upstream.api_call.duration_ms metric to GitHubUpstreamRemote
suggestions.rationale: The OTel observability spec calls for a codeybox.upstream.api_call.duration_ms histogram tagged by endpoint and status_code. This PR omits it because implementing it would require modifying GitHubUpstreamRemote (and other IUpstreamRemote implementations) to emit per-endpoint metrics. The HttpClient instrumentation added in this PR already provides generic http.client.duration spans and metrics; the custom upstream metric would add CodeyBox-semantic endpoint labels (e.g. 'create_pr', 'push_ref') that aren't derivable from the HTTP path alone.
